about: Words and phrases that hold a rating's comment for review (docs/04 control 5). Edit freely, then redeploy. Whole words only; case, accents, look-alike digits (0=o, 1=i, 3=e, 4=a, 5=s, @=a, $=s) and letters repeated in a row are ignored, so one spelling covers 'Fuuuck' and 'f0ck'. A held rating counts only after an admin releases it on /admin/review. Avoid words that are also dish names or everyday words.
